criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (carry-forward consistency), Criterion 3 (Decision Criteria evidence), Criterion 5 (Economic Buyer/ICP assessment)
suggested_change: Clarify: (1) Carry-forward rule applies only when NO new call data exists; if new call added, prior scores must be re-justified with cumulative evidence or explicitly downgraded with contradictory evidence cited. (2) Decision Criteria evidence requirement: accept prospect-articulated technical requirements from cumulative_calls_context as valid evidence without requiring redundant quotes per call. (3) Economic Buyer/ICP: define whether absence of named EB is a failure (Criterion 5) or if scale/infrastructure signals suffice for ICP validation.
